title.zh: 卷十五 本紀第十五 孝宗
title.raw: 卷十五 本紀第十五 孝宗 Volume 15 Annals 15: Xiaozong

sentences.zh: 孝宗建天明道誠純中正聖文神武至仁大德敬皇帝，[一]諱祐樘，憲宗第三子也。

translations.literal: The Xiaozong Emperor, Establishing Heaven, Illuminating the Way, Sincere, Pure, Upright, and Central, Sagely in Culture, Spiritually Martial, Utmost in Benevolence, Great in Virtue, and Reverent, taboo name Youcheng, was the Xianzong Emperor's third son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozong—honored after death as one who established Heaven, illumined the Way, and united sincerity, purity, uprightness, centrality, sagely culture, spiritual martial prowess, utmost benevolence, great virtue, and reverence—was named Zhu Youcheng and was the third son of Emperor Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 母淑妃紀氏，成化六年七月生帝於西宮。

translations.literal: His mother was Worthy Consort Ji; in Chenghua year six, seventh month, the Emperor was born in the Western Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Worthy Consort Ji. In the seventh month of Chenghua six the future emperor was born in the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 時萬貴妃專寵，宮中莫敢言。

translations.literal: At the time the Noble Consort Wan monopolized favor, and none in the palace dared speak.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Wan then held the emperor's exclusive favor, and no one in the inner quarters dared reveal the child's existence.

sentences.zh: 悼恭太子薨後，憲宗始知之，育周太后宮中。

translations.literal: After the Lamented and Respectful Crown Prince died, the Xianzong Emperor first learned of it and reared him in the Dowager Empress Zhou's palace.
translations.idiomatic: Only after Crown Prince Youji died did Xianzong learn of Zhu Youcheng and had him raised in the household of Empress Dowager Zhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年，敕禮部命名，大學士商輅等因以建儲請。

translations.literal: In year eleven an edict ordered the Ministry of Rites to grant a name; Grand Secretaries Shang Lu and others thereupon memorialized to establish the heir.
translations.idiomatic: In Chenghua eleven the throne ordered the Ministry of Rites to give the boy a personal name, and Grand Secretaries led by Shang Lu memorialized to install him as heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 是年六月，淑妃暴薨，帝年六歲，哀慕如成人。

translations.literal: That year, sixth month, Worthy Consort Ji died suddenly; the Emperor was six years old and mourned with the grief of an adult.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of that year Worthy Consort Ji died suddenly. The boy was six and mourned with an adult's depth of grief.

sentences.zh: 十一月，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: Eleventh month: he was installed as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was formally named crown prince.

sentences.zh: 二十三年八月，憲宗崩。

translations.literal: In Chenghua year twenty-three, eighth month, the Xianzong Emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Chenghua twenty-three Emperor Xianzong died.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renyin: he assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin, Zhu Youcheng ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，以明年為弘治元年。

translations.literal: Great pardon under Heaven; the coming year was made Hongzhi year one.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the following year was declared the first year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 丁未，斥諸佞倖侍郎李孜省、太監梁芳、外戚萬喜及其黨，謫戍有差。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the various fawning favorites—Vice Minister Li Zisheng, eunuch Liang Fang, maternal kin Wan Xi, and their faction—were expelled and banished to frontier service in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the court expelled the sycophants—Vice Minister Li Zisheng, the eunuch Liang Fang, the Wan consort's kin Wan Xi, and their clique—and sent them into exile on the frontiers in differing grades.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁卯，汰傳奉官，罷右通政任傑、侍郎蒯鋼等千餘人，論罪戍斥。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day dingmao: supernumerary appointees were cut; Right Assistant Commissioner of Transmission Ren Jie, Vice Minister Kuai Gang, and more than a thousand others were dismissed, sentenced, and banished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on dingmao, supernumerary offices were abolished; Ren Jie, right assistant commissioner of transmission, Vice Minister Kuai Gang, and more than a thousand others were removed, punished, and driven from office.

sentences.zh: 革法王、佛子、國師、真人封號。

translations.literal: Titles of Dharma King, Buddha Son, State Preceptor, and Perfected Man were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The court abolished the ranks of Dharma King, Buddha Son, State Preceptor, and Perfected Man.

sentences.zh: 乙亥。

translations.literal: Day yihai.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai.

sentences.zh: 尊皇太后周氏為太皇太后，皇后王氏為皇太后。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager Zhou was honored Grand Empress Dowager, and the Empress Wang was honored Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Zhou was elevated to grand empress dowager and Empress Wang was made empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丙子，立妃張氏為皇后。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: Consort Zhang was installed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Consort Zhang was enthroned as empress.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，萬安罷。

translations.literal: Day dinghai: Wan An was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Wan An was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，追諡母淑妃為孝穆皇太后。

translations.literal: Day renchen: the late mother Worthy Consort was posthumously honored Empress Dowager Xiaomu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the emperor's mother, Worthy Consort Ji, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager Xiaomu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，吏部左侍郎兼翰林學士徐溥入閣預機務。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Left Vice Minister of Personnel and Hanlin Academician Xu Pu entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Xu Pu, left vice minister of personnel and Hanlin academician, joined the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，尹直罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guichou: Yin Zhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guichou, Yin Zhi was removed from office.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詹事劉健為禮部侍郎兼翰林學士，入閣預機務。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Junior Mentor Liu Jian was made Vice Minister of Rites and Hanlin Academician and entered the Grand Secretariat to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Junior Mentor Liu Jian was appointed vice minister of rites and Hanlin academician and entered the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 戊午，下梁芳、李孜省於獄。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: Liang Fang and Li Zisheng were cast into prison.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Liang Fang and Li Zisheng were thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，葬純皇帝於茂陵。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day renwu: the Pure Emperor was buried at Maoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu, the late Xianzong Emperor was buried at Maoling.

sentences.zh: 是月，免江西、湖廣被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, land tax and grain tribute in disaster-stricken Jiangxi and Huguang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month land tax and grain tribute were forgiven in disaster-hit Jiangxi and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、暹羅、哈密、土魯番、烏斯藏、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Siam, Hami, Turfan, U-Tsang, and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute missions came from Annam, Siam, Hami, Turfan, U-Tsang, and Ryukyu.

sentences.zh: 封占城王子古來為王，諭安南黎灝還占城侵地。

translations.literal: The prince of Champa, Gu Lai, was enfeoffed king; Annam's Li Hao was instructed to return Champa's seized territory.
translations.idiomatic: Gu Lai, prince of Champa, was enfeoffed as king, and Li Hao of Annam was ordered to restore the lands Champa had lost to him.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year one.
translations.idiomatic: The first year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年春正月己亥，享太廟。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year one, spring, first month, day jihai: the Imperial Ancestors were sacrificed to at the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Hongzhi one, on jihai, the emperor offered at the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Day bingwu: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 己未，始考察鎮守武臣。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: review of frontier garrison military officers was begun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the court began its first systematic review of frontier garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 二月戊戌，祭社稷。

translations.literal: Second month, day wuxu: the altars of soil and grain were sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuxu, the emperor sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，耕耤田。

translations.literal: Day dingwei: the sacred plowing field was tilled.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the emperor plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 封哈密左都督罕慎為忠順王。

translations.literal: Hami Guard Left Commissioner-in-chief Han Shen was enfeoffed Prince of Loyal Submission.
translations.idiomatic: Han Shen, left commissioner-in-chief of the Hami Guard, was enfeoffed as Prince of Loyal Submission.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，禁廷臣請託公事。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: court ministers were forbidden to solicit favors on public business.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the throne forbade court officials to use public business to seek private favors.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，疏文武大臣及中外四品以上官姓名，揭文華殿壁。

translations.literal: Third month, day yichou: the names of civil and military grandees and all officials within and without of the fourth rank and above were listed and posted on the wall of the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yichou, the court posted on the Wenhua Hall wall a roster of leading civil and military ministers and every official at the fourth rank and above, inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，釋奠於先師孔子。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: the sacrifice to the First Teacher Confucius was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the court performed the Confucian sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，小王子寇蘭州，都指揮廖斌擊敗之。

translations.literal: Day yihai: the Little Prince raided Lanzhou; Regional Commander Liao Bin defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Little Prince raided Lanzhou and was beaten back by Regional Commander Liao Bin.

sentences.zh: 丙子，御經筵。

translations.literal: Day bingzi: the Classics Colloquium was attended in person.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the emperor attended the Classics Colloquium in person.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，命儒臣日講。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: Confucian officials were ordered to lecture daily.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Confucian lecturers were ordered to expound the classics daily.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，以天暑錄囚。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, day jiayin: because of summer heat, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, the heat prompted a review of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 嗣後歲以為常。

translations.literal: Henceforth this was done annually as a rule.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the summer prisoner review became an annual practice.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon day guisi: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the sixth month, guisi, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，減浙江銀課，汰管理銀場官。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day wuchen: Zhejiang's silver levy was reduced and silver-mine supervisory officials were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuchen, the court cut Zhejiang's silver levy and abolished officials supervising the silver mines.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，小王子犯山丹、永昌。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: the Little Prince invaded Shandan and Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi, the Little Prince struck Shandan and Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，犯獨石、馬營。

translations.literal: Day xinhai: he invaded Dushi and Maying.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he raided Dushi and Maying.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，赈湖廣、四川饑。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day yimao: famine in Huguang and Sichuan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on yimao, relief was sent to famine in Huguang and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，妖僧繼曉伏誅。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jiashen: the sorcerer-monk Jixiao was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen, the sorcerer-monk Jixiao was put to death.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，免河南被災秋糧。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: autumn grain tribute in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou autumn grain tribute was forgiven in disaster-hit Henan.

sentences.zh: 是年，土魯番殺忠順王罕慎，復據哈密。

translations.literal: That year, Turfan killed the Prince of Loyal Submission Han Shen and again seized Hami.
translations.idiomatic: That year Turfan murdered Prince Han Shen of Loyal Submission and reoccupied Hami.

sentences.zh: 琉球、占城、撒馬兒罕、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu, Champa, Samarkand, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Embassies came from Ryukyu, Champa, Samarkand, and U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year two.
translations.idiomatic: The second year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丁卯，收已故內臣賜田，給百姓。

translations.literal: Year two, spring, first month, day dingmao: deceased inner eunuchs' granted fields were confiscated and given to the common people.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on dingmao, lands once granted to dead palace eunuchs were seized and distributed to commoners.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Day xinwei: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月癸巳，赈四川饑。

translations.literal: Second month, day guisi: famine in Sichuan was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guisi, relief was sent to famine in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，免陝西被災秋糧三分之二。

translations.literal: Third month, day jiwei: two-thirds of autumn grain tribute in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiwei, two-thirds of Shaanxi's autumn grain tribute was forgiven where disaster had struck.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，閉會川銀礦。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the Huichuan Guard silver mine was closed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Huichuan Guard silver mine was shut down.

sentences.zh: 夏五月庚申，河決開封，入沁河，役五萬人治之。

translations.literal: Summer, fifth month, day gengshen: the Yellow River burst at Kaifeng and entered the Qin River; fifty thousand men were levied to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on gengshen, the Yellow River broke its banks at Kaifeng and poured into the Qin River; fifty thousand laborers were mobilized for repairs.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，以京師霪雨、南京大風雷修省，求直言。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, day guihai: because of incessant rain in the capital and great wind and thunder in Nanjing, the court undertook self-examination and sought forthright memorials.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guihai, flooding rains in the capital and violent wind and thunder in Nanjing moved the throne to order court-wide self-examination and invite blunt memorials.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，赈畿內水災，免稅糧，給貧民麥種。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the capital region's flood victims were relieved; land tax and grain tribute were remitted and wheat seed was given to the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the court relieved flood victims in the metropolitan districts, remitted tax and grain, and issued wheat seed to the destitute.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，復四川流民復業者雜役三年。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingyou: miscellaneous corvée for Sichuan displaced persons who returned to their occupations was remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingyou, Sichuan refugees who resumed farming were exempted from miscellaneous corvée for three years.

sentences.zh: 己酉，憲宗神主祔太廟。

translations.literal: Day jiyou: the Xianzong Emperor's spirit tablet was placed in the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou the spirit tablet of Emperor Xianzong was installed in the Imperial Temple.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，順天饑，發粟平糶。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: Shuntian suffered famine; grain was issued for sale at fair price.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuwu, famine struck Shuntian and the government sold grain from the granaries at reduced price.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon day jiashen: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the twelfth month, jiashen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，賜于謙諡，立祠曰「旌功」。

translations.literal: Day xinmao: Yu Qian was granted a posthumous title and a shrine called "Commending Merit" was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Yu Qian was given a posthumous name and a shrine entitled Commending Merit was founded in his honor.

sentences.zh: 是年，土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Turfan sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 撒馬兒罕貢獅子、鸚鵡，之。

translations.literal: Samarkand presented lions and parrots; they were refused.
translations.idiomatic: Samarkand offered lions and parrots; the court declined them.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year three.
translations.idiomatic: The third year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月甲子，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: Year three, spring, first month, day jiazi: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on jiazi, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，免河南被災秋糧。

translations.literal: Second month, day renchen: autumn grain tribute in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen, autumn grain tribute was forgiven in disaster-hit Henan.

sentences.zh: 甲午，戶部請免南畿、湖廣稅糧。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: the Ministry of Revenue requested remission of land tax and grain tribute in the Southern Metropolitan Region and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Ministry of Revenue petitioned to remit tax and grain in the Southern Metropolitan Region and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「凶歲義當損上益下。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "In famine years righteousness demands that those above reduce themselves to benefit those below.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "In years of dearth, duty requires that the ruler take less so the people may gain.

sentences.zh: 必欲取盈，如病民何。

translations.literal: If one must take a full quota, how is that unlike afflicting the people?"
translations.idiomatic: If the treasury must still be filled to the brim, how is that any different from sickening the people?"

sentences.zh: 」悉從之。

translations.literal: All was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The petitions were all approved.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，命天下預備倉積粟，以里數多寡為差，不及額者罪之。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingchen: the realm was ordered to stock the reserve granaries with grain, graded by number of li in each district; those falling short of the quota were punished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingchen, the throne ordered every prefecture to fill its reserve granaries according to district size, with penalties for shortfalls.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賜錢福等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: Day gengwu: Qian Fu and others were granted jinshi with first, second, and third rank distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Qian Fu and the other metropolitan graduates received jinshi honors in graded ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，侍郎張海、通政使元守直閱邊。

translations.literal: Day jiaxu: Vice Minister Zhang Hai and Commissioner of Transmission Yuan Shouzhi inspected the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Vice Minister Zhang Hai and Commissioner of Transmission Yuan Shouzhi were sent to inspect the border defenses.

sentences.zh: 秋九月庚戌，禁內府加派供御物料。

translations.literal: Autumn, ninth month, day gengxu: extra requisitions of supplies for the inner palace were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn, on gengxu, supplemental levies for the inner palace were banned.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸巳，禁宗室、勳戚奏請田土及受人投獻。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guisi: imperial clansmen and meritorious kin were forbidden to memorialize for land or accept donated estates.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guisi, the throne forbade imperial princes and ennobled kin either to petition for land grants or to accept estates offered them.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲辰，停工役，罷內官燒造瓷器。

translations.literal: Winter, eleventh month, day jiachen: labor corvée was halted and inner eunuchs' porcelain manufacture was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiachen, corvée projects were suspended and palace eunuchs were stopped from firing imperial porcelain.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，以彗星見，敕臣修省，陳軍民利病。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinhai: because a comet appeared, ministers were ordered to undertake self-examination and set forth what benefited or harmed soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinhai, a comet prompted an edict ordering ministers to examine themselves and report on policies that helped or harmed troops and commoners.

sentences.zh: 己未，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，減供御品物，罷明年上元燈火。

translations.literal: Day renxu: items for imperial use were reduced and the First Yuan Festival lanterns for the coming year were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the court cut palace provisions and canceled the coming year's Lantern Festival illuminations.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、安南、哈密、撒馬兒罕、天方、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu, Annam, Hami, Samarkand, Mecca, and Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year tribute missions came from Ryukyu, Annam, Hami, Samarkand, Mecca, and Turfan.

sentences.zh: 弘治四年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year four.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月癸未，以修省罷上元節假。

translations.literal: Year four, spring, first month, day guiwei: because of self-examination the First Yuan Festival holiday was canceled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, in the first month of spring, on guiwei, the court canceled the Lantern Festival holiday as part of its austerity of self-examination.

sentences.zh: 己丑，大祀天地於南郊，停慶成宴。

translations.literal: Day jichou: the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb; the celebratory feast was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth but omitted the usual celebratory feast.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，敕法司曰：「曩因天道示異，敕天下諸司審錄重囚，發遣數十百人。

translations.literal: Second month, day jisi: an edict to the judiciary said: "Formerly, because Heaven showed anomalies, all offices throughout the realm were ordered to review serious prisoners and release several tens or hundreds of persons.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jisi, an edict to the law courts read: "Earlier, when Heaven displayed omens, I ordered every yamen in the empire to re-examine capital cases and release several tens or hundreds of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 朕以為與其寬之於終，孰若謹之於始。

translations.literal: I consider that rather than showing leniency at the end, it is better to be strict at the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that leniency at the end is no match for care at the beginning.

sentences.zh: 嗣後兩京三法司及天下問刑官，務存心仁恕，持法公平，詳審其情罪所當，庶不背於古聖人欽恤之訓。

translations.literal: Henceforth the two capitals' three judicial offices and all penal officials under Heaven must keep their hearts benevolent and forgiving, hold the law fair, and examine closely what the circumstances and offenses warrant, so as not to betray the ancient sages' teaching of reverent compassion."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter the three judicial offices of both capitals and every penal official in the realm must judge with humane hearts and even hand, weighing circumstance and crime with care, lest they betray the sages' doctrine of reverent mercy."

sentences.zh: 」六月辛亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day xinhai: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinhai, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚戌，蘇、松、浙江水，停本年織造。

translations.literal: Autumn, eighth month, day gengxu: Suzhou, Songjiang, and Zhejiang flooded; that year's weaving levy was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengxu, floods hit Suzhou, Songjiang, and Zhejiang and the court halted that year's textile levies.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，南京地震。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己未，封皇弟祐榰為壽王，祐汝王，祐涇王，祐樞榮王，祐楷申王。

translations.literal: Day jiwei: the imperial younger brother Youwei was enfeoffed Prince of Shou, Youyuan Prince of Ru, Youkui Prince of Jing, Youshu Prince of Rong, and Youkai Prince of Shen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the emperor enfeoffed his brothers Zhu Youwei as Prince of Shou, Zhu Youyuan as Prince of Ru, Zhu Youkui as Prince of Jing, Zhu Youshu as Prince of Rong, and Zhu Youkai as Prince of Shen.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙辰，以皇長子生，詔天下。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, day bingchen: because the eldest imperial son was born, an edict was issued to the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingchen, the birth of the heir prompted an edict to the empire.

sentences.zh: 戊午，河溢，赈河南被災者。

translations.literal: Day wuwu: the Yellow River overflowed; victims in Henan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the Yellow River burst its banks and relief was sent to the afflicted in Henan.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，禮部尚書丘濬兼文淵閣大學士預機務。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Minister of Rites Qiu Jun was also made Grand Academician of the Wenyuan Pavilion and entered to deliberate on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Minister of Rites Qiu Jun was additionally appointed grand academician of the Wenyuan Pavilion and joined the Grand Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，赈南畿災。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day gengchen: the Southern Metropolitan Region's disaster victims were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, relief was sent to disaster victims in the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲子，土魯番以哈密地及金印來歸。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiazi: Turfan returned Hami territory and the gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiazi, Turfan restored Hami and its gold seal to the Ming.

sentences.zh: 是年，暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Siam sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 弘治五年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year five.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬午，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day renwu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on renwu, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅，命陝巴襲封忠順王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day bingyin, Shaanba was ordered to inherit the enfeoffment as Prince of Zhongshun.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin, Shaanba was commanded to succeed to the title Prince of Zhongshun.

sentences.zh: 庚午，減陝西織造絨毼之半。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Shaanxi textile manufacture of pile rugs was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Shaanxi's state-run manufacture of pile rugs was cut by half.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，立皇子厚照為皇太子，大赦。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day wuyin, the prince Houzhao was established as crown prince; a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, Prince Houzhao was named crown prince and the realm was granted a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 錄太祖廟配享功臣絕封者後。

translations.literal: Descendants were recorded for meritorious officials enshrined with Taizu in the ancestral temple whose lines of enfeoffment had ended.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants were enrolled for meritorious officials enshrined with Taizu whose enfeoffments had died out.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，廣西副總兵馬俊、參議馬鉉、千戶王珊等討古田叛僮，遇伏死。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Guangxi Vice Commander-in-Chief Ma Jun, Participant Ma Xian, Company Commander Wang Shan, and others campaigned against rebellious Zhuang in Gutian; they fell into an ambush and died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Ma Jun, vice commander-in-chief in Guangxi, Participant Ma Xian, Company Commander Wang Shan, and others attacked rebellious Zhuang in Gutian, walked into an ambush, and were killed.

sentences.zh: 夏六月丁未，免南畿去年被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In summer, sixth month, on the day dingwei, tax grain in the Southern Metropolitan Region for the previous year's disasters was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on dingwei, last year's disaster-stricken tax grain in the Southern Metropolitan Region was forgiven.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲午，赈南京、浙江、山東饑。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day jiawu, famine relief was provided to Nanjing, Zhejiang, and Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiawu, famine relief was sent to Nanjing, Zhejiang, and Shandong.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，劉吉致仕。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guimao, Liu Ji retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guimao, Liu Ji retired.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，停蘇、松、浙江額外織造，召督造官還。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, extra textile production in Suzhou, Songjiang, and Zhejiang was halted, and the supervising officials were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou extra weaving in Suzhou, Songjiang, and Zhejiang was stopped and the supervising officials were recalled.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，湖廣總兵官鎮遠侯顧溥、貴州巡撫都御史鄧廷瓚、太監江會師討貴州黑苗。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day renxu, Huguang Commander-in-Chief Marquis of Zhenyuan Gu Pu, Guizhou Grand Coordinator Censor-in-Chief Deng Tingzan, and the eunuch Jiang Bin joined forces to campaign against the Black Miao of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renxu, Huguang commander-in-chief Marquis of Zhenyuan Gu Pu, Guizhou grand coordinator Deng Tingzan, and the eunuch Jiang Bin united their armies against the Black Miao of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，閉溫、處銀坑。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingshen, the silver mines of Wenzhou and Chuzhou were closed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingshen, the silver mines of Wenzhou and Chuzhou were shut down.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁巳，荊王見潚有罪，廢為庶人。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dingsi, Prince of Jing Jian Ze was found guilty and degraded to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingsi, Prince of Jing Jian Ze was judged guilty and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、烏斯藏、土魯番入貢。

translations.literal: That year Ryukyu, U-Tsang, and Turfan sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Tibet, and Turfan sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 火剌札國貢方物，不受，給廩食遣還。

translations.literal: The country of Huolazha presented tribute goods; they were not accepted; grain rations were given and the envoys were sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Huolazha sent tribute goods; the court declined them, issued rations, and sent the envoys home.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year six
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi six

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己卯，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day jimao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on jimao, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，錄常遇春、李文忠、鄧愈、湯和後裔，世襲指揮使。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiayin, the descendants of Chang Yuchun, Li Wenzhong, Deng Yu, and Tang He were recorded; they were granted hereditary posts as commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, the lines of Chang Yuchun, Li Wenzhong, Deng Yu, and Tang He were enrolled and granted hereditary commanderships.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，擢布政使劉大夏右副都御史，治張秋決河。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Regional Commissioner Liu Daxia was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief to manage the Zhangqiu breach in the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Regional Commissioner Liu Daxia was promoted to right vice censor-in-chief to manage the Zhangqiu Yellow River breach.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，賜毛澄等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guiwei, Mao Cheng and other successful candidates of the metropolitan examination were granted jinshi ranks and appointments in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiwei, Mao Cheng and other metropolitan graduates received jinshi honors and appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，土魯番速檀阿黑麻襲執陝巴，據哈密。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day jihai, Turfan's Sultan Aheima seized and detained Shaanba and occupied Hami.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jihai, Turfan's sultan Aheima seized Shaanba and occupied Hami.

sentences.zh: 己酉，侍郎張海、都督同知緱謙經略哈密。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Vice Minister Zhang Hai and Regional Military Commissioner of the Second Rank Gou Qian were dispatched to manage Hami.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Vice Minister Zhang Hai and regional military commissioner Gou Qian were sent to manage Hami.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，久旱，敕修省，求直言。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, after prolonged drought, an edict ordered self-examination and called for forthright memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, after long drought, the throne ordered self-examination and called for blunt memorials.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，小王子犯寧夏，殺指揮趙璽。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingyin, the Little Prince raided Ningxia and killed Commander Zhao Xi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin, the Little Prince struck Ningxia and killed Commander Zhao Xi.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，免南京被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day yiwei, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Nanjing was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yiwei, autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-hit Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，捕蝗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengwu, locusts were hunted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengwu, locusts were hunted down.

sentences.zh: 壬申，都御史閔珪擊破古田叛僮。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Censor-in-Chief Min Gui defeated the rebellious Zhuang of Gutian.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Censor-in-Chief Min Gui routed the rebellious Zhuang of Gutian.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲戌，免順天被災夏稅。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day jiaxu, summer tax in disaster-stricken Shuntian was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on jiaxu, summer tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，免陝西被災夏稅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dingyou, summer tax in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou, summer tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，以災傷罷明年上元燈火。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day bingyin, because of disaster damage the Lantern Festival illuminations of the following year were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingyin, disaster losses led the court to cancel the next year's Lantern Festival lights.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，停甘肅織造絨毼。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Gansu manufacture of pile rugs was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen state-run pile-rug manufacture in Gansu was stopped.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，赈京師流民。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengshen, relief was provided to vagrants in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengshen, the capital's homeless were given relief.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，敕天下鎮巡官修省。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jimao, an edict ordered military and surveillance officials throughout the realm to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jimao, an edict ordered frontier and provincial officials everywhere to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、烏斯藏、土魯番、暹羅入貢。

translations.literal: That year Annam, U-Tsang, Turfan, and Siam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Tibet, Turfan, and Siam sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治七年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year seven
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi seven

sentences.zh: 七年春正月丁酉，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day dingyou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on dingyou, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月甲子，以去年冬孝陵風雷之變，遣使祭告，修省，求直言，命內外慎刑獄，決輕繫。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiazi, because of the previous winter's wind and thunder striking Xiaoling, envoys were dispatched to report and offer sacrifices; self-examination was ordered and forthright memorials were sought; officials within and without were commanded to be cautious in criminal cases and to decide minor imprisonments.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiazi, after wind and thunder had struck Xiaoling the previous winter, envoys were sent to report and sacrifice; the court ordered self-examination, sought blunt memorials, and told officials everywhere to handle criminal cases carefully and release light offenders.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，貴州黑苗平。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guisi, the Black Miao of Guizhou were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, the Black Miao of Guizhou were pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊申，兩畿捕蝗。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, locusts were hunted in the Two Capitals region.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen locusts were hunted in the Two Capitals region.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲辰，太監李興、平江伯陳銳同劉大夏治張秋決河。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day jiachen, the eunuch Li Xing and Marquis of Pingjiang Chen Rui, together with Liu Daxia, managed the Zhangqiu breach in the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on jiachen, the eunuch Li Xing and Marquis of Pingjiang Chen Rui joined Liu Daxia in managing the Zhangqiu Yellow River breach.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day yisi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yisi, an earthquake struck the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙午，工部侍郎徐貫、巡撫副都御史何鑑經理南畿水利。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Vice Minister of Works Xu Guan and Vice Grand Coordinator He Jian were assigned to manage waterworks in the Southern Metropolitan Region.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Works Vice Minister Xu Guan and vice grand coordinator He Jian were put in charge of waterworks in the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，以水災停蘇、松諸府所辦物料，留關鈔、戶鹽備赈。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dinghai, because of flooding the materials levied by Suzhou, Songjiang, and other prefectures were halted; transit-tax notes and household salt were retained for famine relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, flooding led the court to stop requisitions from Suzhou, Songjiang, and other prefectures and to keep transit-tax notes and household salt for relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬子，京師地震。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day renzi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on renzi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，張秋河工成。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiaxu, the Zhangqiu river works were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, the Zhangqiu river works were finished.

sentences.zh: 己卯，赈甘、涼被兵軍民，給牛種。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, soldiers and civilians in Ganzhou and Liangzhou who had suffered from warfare were relieved; cattle and seed were provided.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao soldiers and civilians in Ganzhou and Liangzhou harmed by warfare were relieved, and cattle and seed were issued.

sentences.zh: 是年，免北京、河南、湖廣、陝西、山西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That year tax grain in disaster-stricken Beijing, Henan, Huguang, Shaanxi, and Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Beijing, Henan, Huguang, Shaanxi, and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Ryukyu sent a tribute mission.

sentences.zh: 以土魯番據哈密，其貢使。

translations.literal: Because Turfan held Hami, their tribute envoys were detained.
translations.idiomatic: Because Turfan held Hami, its tribute envoys were detained.

sentences.zh: 弘治八年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year eight
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi eight

sentences.zh: 八年春正月乙未，大祀天地於南郊，以太皇太后不豫，免慶成宴。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day yiwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb; because the Grand Empress Dowager was unwell, the celebratory feast was omitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on yiwei, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb; because the grand empress dowager was ill, the celebratory feast was omitted.

sentences.zh: 壬子，甘肅總兵官劉寧敗小王子於涼州。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Gansu Commander-in-Chief Liu Ning defeated the Little Prince at Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Gansu commander-in-chief Liu Ning defeated the Little Prince at Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the new moon day yimao, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the new moon yimao, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊午，丘濬卒。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Qiu Jun died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Qiu Jun died.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，禮部侍郎李東陽、少詹事謝遷入閣預機務。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Li Dongyang, Vice Minister of Rites, and Xie Qian, Junior Mentor, entered the Grand Secretariat to participate in state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Rites Vice Minister Li Dongyang and Junior Mentor Xie Qian entered the Grand Secretariat to take part in state affairs.

sentences.zh: 己卯，黃陵岡河口工成。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the works at the Huanglinggang river mouth were completed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the works at the Huanglinggang river mouth were completed.

sentences.zh: 三月壬辰，免湖廣被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renchen, tax grain in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renchen, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 己亥，寧夏地震。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Ningxia was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai an earthquake struck Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，蘇、松各府治水工成。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day jiayin, water-control works in the prefectures of Suzhou and Songjiang were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiayin, flood-control works in Suzhou and Songjiang were finished.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，諭吏部、都察院，人材進退，考察務得實跡，不可偏聽枉人。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate were instructed that advancement and dismissal of personnel must rest on verified records in inspection, and that partisan or distorted reports must not be heeded.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the Ministry of Personnel and the Censorate were told that promotions and dismissals must follow verified inspection records and must not be swayed by partisan or distorted reports.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，免南畿被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jichou, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jichou, autumn grain tax was remitted in the disaster-hit Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁亥，封宋儒楊時將樂伯，從祀孔子廟庭。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day dinghai, the Song scholar Yang Shi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiangle and granted secondary sacrifice in Confucius's temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dinghai, the Song scholar Yang Shi was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiangle and given secondary place in Confucius's temple.

sentences.zh: 戊子，廣西副總兵歐磐擊破平樂叛瑤。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Guangxi Vice Commander-in-Chief Ou Pan defeated the rebellious Yao of Pingle.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Guangxi vice commander-in-chief Ou Pan routed the rebellious Yao of Pingle.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，以四方災異數見，敕臣修省。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guihai, because calamities and anomalies had repeatedly appeared in all quarters, an edict ordered the ministers to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guihai, as disasters and portents had repeatedly appeared throughout the realm, the throne ordered the ministers to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月己酉，免直隸被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day jiyou, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Zhili was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiyou, autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Zhili.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，巡撫甘肅僉都御史許進、總兵官劉寧入哈密，土魯番遁，遂班師。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinyou, Gansu Grand Coordinator Junior Censor-in-Chief Xu Jin and Commander-in-Chief Liu Ning entered Hami; Turfan fled, and the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, Gansu grand coordinator Xu Jin and commander-in-chief Liu Ning entered Hami; Turfan withdrew, and the army returned.

sentences.zh: 是年，爪哇、占城、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Java, Champa, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Java, Champa, and Tibet sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 乜克力諸部肅州塞求入貢，之。

translations.literal: The Mikeli tribes at the Suzhou frontier pass sought to enter tribute; they were refused.
translations.idiomatic: Mikeli tribes at the Suzhou frontier pass asked to send tribute; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 弘治九年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year nine
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi nine

sentences.zh: 九年春正月壬辰，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day renchen, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on renchen, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，免河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengwu, tax grain in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengwu, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Henan.

sentences.zh: 辛未，右通政張璞、大理少卿馬中錫閱邊。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Right Commissioner for Transmission Zhang Pu and Assistant Chief Law Officer Ma Zhongxi inspected the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Right Commissioner for Transmission Zhang Pu and assistant chief law officer Ma Zhongxi inspected the frontier.

sentences.zh: 三月丙申，賜朱希周等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day bingshen, Zhu Xizhou and other successful candidates of the metropolitan examination were granted jinshi ranks and appointments in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingshen, Zhu Xizhou and other metropolitan graduates received jinshi honors and appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子，以岷王膺奏，逮武岡知州劉遜。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day wuzi, because Prince of Min Ying Pan memorialized, the magistrate of Wugang, Liu Xun, was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on wuzi, after Prince of Min Ying Pan memorialized, Wugang magistrate Liu Xun was arrested.

sentences.zh: 給事中、御史龐泮、劉紳等諫，下錦衣獄，尋釋之。

translations.literal: Remonstrating officials Pang Pan, Liu Shen, and others were imprisoned in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard prison; they were soon released.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrating officials Pang Pan, Liu Shen, and others were jailed in the Embroidered-Uniform Guard prison and soon released.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，免江西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengzi, tax grain in disaster-stricken Jiangxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengzi, tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬寅，免湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, on the day renyin, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on renyin, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，禁勢家侵奪民利。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day jiyou, powerful families were forbidden to seize the people's profits.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou, powerful families were forbidden to seize profits from the common people.

sentences.zh: 是年，日本、疏球、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year Japan, Ryukyu, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Japan, Ryukyu, and Tibet sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治十年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year ten
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi ten

sentences.zh: 十年春正月庚戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day gengxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on gengxu, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，以旱霾修省，求直言。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day xinhai, because of drought haze, self-examination was ordered and forthright memorials were sought.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinhai, drought haze led the court to order self-examination and seek blunt memorials.

sentences.zh: 甲子，召大學士劉健、李東陽、謝遷於文華殿議庶政，後以為常。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Grand Secretaries Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian were summoned to the Wenhua Hall to discuss general administration; this later became regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Grand Secretaries Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian were summoned to the Wenhua Hall to discuss routine administration, and the practice later became regular.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊辰，小王子犯潮河川。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day wuchen, the Little Prince raided Chaohu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuchen, the Little Prince raided Chaohu River.

sentences.zh: 己巳，犯大同。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, he raided Datong.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he struck Datong.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，侍郎劉大夏、李介理宣府、大同軍餉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jimao, Vice Ministers Liu Daxia and Li Jie were assigned to manage military provisions for Xuanfu and Datong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jimao, Vice Ministers Liu Daxia and Li Jie were put in charge of military provisions for Xuanfu and Datong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，都督楊玉帥京營軍，備永平。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day guichou, Regional Commander Yang Yu led the capital army to prepare defenses at Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on guichou, Regional Commander Yang Yu led the capital army to ready the defenses at Yongping.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月庚子，土魯番歸陝巴，乞通貢。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day gengzi, Turfan returned Shaanba and begged to resume tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on gengzi, Turfan returned Shaanba and asked to resume tribute.

sentences.zh: 是年，免南畿、山西、陝西被災稅糧，赈山東、四川水災。

translations.literal: That year tax grain in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region, Shanxi, and Shaanxi was remitted; flood victims in Shandong and Sichuan were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax grain was forgiven in the disaster-hit Southern Metropolitan Region, Shanxi, and Shaanxi, and flood victims in Shandong and Sichuan were relieved.

sentences.zh: 安南、暹羅、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: Annam, Siam, and U-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Annam, Siam, and Tibet sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治十一年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year eleven
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi eleven

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月丁未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In spring, first month, on the day dingwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring, on dingwei, the Emperor offered the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳，小王子遣使求貢。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jisi, the Little Prince sent envoys requesting to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jisi, the Little Prince sent envoys asking to offer tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊申，甘肅參將楊翥敗小王子於黑山。

translations.literal: In summer, fifth month, on the day wushen, Gansu Regional Vice Commander Yang Chong defeated the Little Prince at Heishan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wushen, Gansu vice commander Yang Chong defeated the Little Prince at Heishan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己酉，總制三邊都御史王越襲小王子於賀蘭山後，敗之。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day jiyou, Supreme Commander of the Three Frontiers Censor-in-Chief Wang Yue raided the Little Prince behind Helan Mountain and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiyou, supreme commander of the three frontiers Wang Yue struck the Little Prince behind Helan Mountain and routed him.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，徐溥致仕。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Xu Pu retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Xu Pu retired.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，赈祥符民被河患者。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day guiwei, the people of Xiangfu who had suffered from the river were relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guiwei, people in Xiangfu harmed by the river were given relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅，命工作不得役團營軍士。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day bingyin, it was ordered that labor projects must not employ regiment-camp soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on bingyin, the court ruled that public works must not conscript regiment-camp soldiers.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，清寧宮災。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the Qingning Palace burned.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Qingning Palace burned.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕臣修省，求直言，罷明年上元燈火。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict ordered all officials to practice self-examination, solicited forthright counsel, and canceled next year's Lantern Festival displays.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor ordered his ministers to undertake court-wide self-examination, called for frank memorials, and canceled the next year's First Full Moon lantern displays.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，免陝西織造羊絨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renzi, Shaanxi's manufacture of lamb's-wool fabrics was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi, the court ended Shaanxi's manufacture of lamb's-wool fabrics.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the new moon day renxu in the intercalary month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary month's new moon renxu there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，罷福建織造綵布。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Fujian's manufacture of colored cloth was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the court ended Fujian's manufacture of colored cloth.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，禁中外奢靡踰制。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengzi, extravagance beyond regulation was forbidden inside and outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, the throne forbade extravagance beyond statute at court and throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以清寧宮災詔赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, because of a fire at the Qingning Palace, an edict proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, after fire struck the Qingning Palace, the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是年，免山西、陝西、兩畿、廣西、廣東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That year, tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Shanxi, Shaanxi, the Two Metropolitan Regions, Guangxi, and Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax grain was forgiven in disaster districts of Shanxi, Shaanxi, the Two Metropolitan Regions, Guangxi, and Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 土魯番、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: Turfan and Ü-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Turfan and Ü-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治十二年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year twelve.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛未，大祀天地於南郊，免慶成宴。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, first month, on the day xinwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb, and the post-sacrifice celebratory banquet was waived.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, in the first month of spring, on xinwei, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth and waived the celebratory feast.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，免山東被災夏稅。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day renchen, summer tax in disaster-stricken Shandong was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen, summer tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Shandong.

sentences.zh: 戊申，嚴左道惑之禁。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the ban on heterodox ways misleading the masses was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the throne strictly enforced the ban on heterodox cults that misled the people.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，賜倫文等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingchou, Lun Wenxu and other successful candidates of the metropolitan examination were granted jinshi ranks and appointments in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingchou, Lun Wenxu and other metropolitan graduates received jinshi honors and appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，敕宣、大、延綏備邊。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day guisi, an edict ordered Xuanfu, Datong, and Yan-sui to ready their border defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guisi, the throne ordered the Xuanfu, Datong, and Yan-sui sectors to ready their defenses.

sentences.zh: 是月，免湖廣、江西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That month, tax grain in disaster-stricken Huguang and Jiangxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month tax grain was forgiven in disaster-stricken Huguang and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，免南畿被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wuyin, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin, autumn grain tax was remitted in the disaster-hit Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，闕里先師廟災，遣使慰祭。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiachen, the temple of the First Teacher at Qufu was destroyed by fire, and envoys were dispatched to offer solace and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, fire destroyed the Confucius temple at Qufu; the court sent envoys to offer consolation and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，免河南、南畿被災夏稅。

translations.literal: In autumn, eighth month, summer tax in disaster-stricken Henan and the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn summer tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Henan and the Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，普安賊婦米魯作亂。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day renwu, the bandit woman Milu of Pu'an rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renwu, Milu, a rebel woman of Pu'an, rose in arms.

sentences.zh: [三]甲申，重建清寧宮成。

translations.literal: [3] On the day jiashen, reconstruction of the Qingning Palace was completed.
translations.idiomatic: [3] On jiashen reconstruction of the Qingning Palace was completed.

sentences.zh: 是年，占城、烏斯藏、土魯番、爪哇、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Champa, Ü-Tsang, Turfan, Java, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Champa, Ü-Tsang, Turfan, Java, and Samarkand sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治十三年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year thirteen.
translations.idiomatic: The thirteenth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月乙丑，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, first month, on the day yichou, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, in the first month of spring, on yichou, he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月戊子，免山西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuzi, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuzi, tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，定問刑條例。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the regulations on criminal inquiry were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the court fixed the regulations governing criminal inquiry.

sentences.zh: 乙未，嚴旌舉連坐之法。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the law of joint punishment for recommendation offenses was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the throne strictly enforced joint-punishment rules for corrupt recommendations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，火篩寇大同，遊擊將軍王杲敗績於威遠。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, Huosai raided Datong, and Guerrilla General Wang Gao was defeated at Weiyuan Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Huosai struck Datong; Guerrilla General Wang Gao was routed at Weiyuan Guard.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，平江伯陳銳為靖虜將軍，充總兵官，太監金輔監軍，戶部左侍郎許進提督軍務，禦之。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Chen Rui, Baron of Pingjiang, was made Pacifying the Barbarians General and filled the post of supreme commander; the eunuch Jin Fu supervised the army; Left Vice Minister of Revenue Xu Jin directed military affairs, to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Chen Rui, Baron of Pingjiang, was made Pacifying the Barbarians General and supreme commander, with the eunuch Jin Fu overseeing the army and Revenue Vice Minister Xu Jin directing operations against the invaders.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the new moon day jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the new moon jiayin, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，召大學士劉健、李東陽、謝遷於平臺，議京營將領。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Grand Secretaries Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian were summoned to the Lecture Platform to deliberate on commanders of the capital garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Grand Secretaries Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian were summoned to the Lecture Platform to discuss capital-garrison commanders.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，火篩大舉入寇大同左，遊擊將軍張俊禦之。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Huosai launched a major raid into Datong Left Guard, and Guerrilla General Zhang Jun resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Huosai launched a major invasion of Datong Left Guard; Guerrilla General Zhang Jun met and resisted the attack.

sentences.zh: [四]六月甲申，免江西被災秋糧，停山、陝採辦物料。

translations.literal: [4] In the sixth month, on the day jiashen, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Jiangxi was remitted, and procurement of goods in Shanxi and Shaanxi was halted.
translations.idiomatic: [4] In the sixth month, on jiashen, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-hit Jiangxi and procurement in Shanxi and Shaanxi was suspended.

sentences.zh: 庚子，召陳銳、金輔還，保國公朱暉、太監扶安往代，益兵禦寇。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Chen Rui and Jin Fu were recalled; Defender of the State Zhu Hui and the eunuch Fu An were sent to replace them, with added troops to resist the raiders.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Chen Rui and Jin Fu were recalled; Defender of the State Zhu Hui and the eunuch Fu An replaced them with reinforcements to repel the raiders.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day jisi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，赈江西水災。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day xinmao, relief was extended to victims of flooding in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinmao, the court gave relief to Jiangxi flood victims.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，兩京地震。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day wushen, both capitals were shaken by earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wushen, both capitals were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是月，小王子諸部寇大同。

translations.literal: That month, divisions of the Little Prince raided Datong.
translations.idiomatic: That month divisions of the northern Little Prince struck Datong.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，火篩寇大同，南掠百餘里。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinchou, Huosai raided Datong and plundered southward for more than a hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, Huosai struck Datong and raided southward for more than a hundred li.

sentences.zh: 是年，小王子部入居河套，犯延綏神木堡。

translations.literal: That year, a division of the Little Prince settled in the Ordos bend and attacked Shenmu Fort in Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: That year a division of the Little Prince moved into the Ordos bend and attacked Shenmu Fort on the Yan-sui frontier.

sentences.zh: 琉球、土魯番、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: Ryukyu, Turfan, and Ü-Tsang sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu, Turfan, and Ü-Tsang sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治十四年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year fourteen.
translations.idiomatic: The fourteenth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月庚戌朔，陝西地大震。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, spring, first month, on the new moon day gengxu, Shaanxi was shaken by a great earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, on the new moon gengxu in the first month of spring, Shaanxi was shaken by a great earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，罷陝西織造中官。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jihai, the eunuch supervisors of weaving in Shaanxi were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai, the court abolished Shaanxi's eunuch supervisors of weaving.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，工部侍郎李鐩總督延綏邊餉。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day gengchen, Vice Minister of Works Li Yong was made overall superintendent of Yan-sui frontier supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengchen, Works Vice Minister Li Yong was appointed to superintend Yan-sui frontier supplies.

sentences.zh: 戊子，保國公朱暉、提督軍務都御史史琳、監軍太監苗逵分道進師延綏。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Defender of the State Zhu Hui, Military Affairs Superintendent Censor-in-chief Shi Lin, and Army Supervisor Eunuch Miao Kui advanced on Yan-sui by separate routes.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhu Hui, Defender of the State, Military Affairs Superintendent Shi Lin, and Army Supervisor Miao Kui advanced on Yan-sui by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，免陝西、山西物料。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, materials levied in Shaanxi and Shanxi were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu levies of materials in Shaanxi and Shanxi were remitted.

sentences.zh: 是月，火篩諸部寇固原。

translations.literal: That month, various divisions of Huosai raided Guyuan.
translations.idiomatic: That month Huosai's allied divisions raided Guyuan.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，赈大同被兵軍民，免稅糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengxu, soldiers and civilians of Datong who had suffered from warfare were given relief, and tax grain was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengxu, the court relieved Datong's war-stricken soldiers and civilians and remitted their tax grain.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，免陝西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shaanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，修闕里先師廟。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the temple of the First Teacher at Qufu was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen work began to repair the Confucius temple at Qufu.

sentences.zh: 命各布政使司上地里圖。

translations.literal: The throne ordered each provincial administration commission to submit land maps.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered every provincial administration to submit cadastral maps.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸巳，分遣侍郎何鑑、大理寺丞吳一貫赈卹兩畿、山東、河南饑民。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day guisi, Vice Ministers He Jian and Assistant Commissioner of the Court of Judicial Review Wu Yiguan were separately dispatched to give relief to famine victims in the Two Metropolitan Regions, Shandong, and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on guisi, Vice Minister He Jian and Review Assistant Commissioner Wu Yiguan were sent separately to relieve famine in the Two Metropolitan Regions, Shandong, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，遼東大饑，赈之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day wuchen, Liaodong suffered a great famine and was given relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, a great famine struck Liaodong and the court gave relief.

sentences.zh: 是月，寇出河套。

translations.literal: That month, raiders came out of the Ordos bend.
translations.idiomatic: That month raiders issued from the Ordos bend.

sentences.zh: 是年，免湖廣、江西、山西、山東、陝西、河南、畿內被災稅糧。

translations.literal: That year, tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Huguang, Jiangxi, Shanxi, Shandong, Shaanxi, Henan, and the metropolitan districts.
translations.idiomatic: That year tax grain was forgiven in disaster districts of Huguang, Jiangxi, Shanxi, Shandong, Shaanxi, Henan, and the metropolitan regions.

sentences.zh: 安南、琉球入貢。

translations.literal: Annam and Ryukyu sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam and Ryukyu sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治十五年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: The fifteenth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 十五年春正月丙子，朱暉帥師還。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, spring, first month, on the day bingzi, Zhu Hui led the army back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, in the first month of spring, on bingzi, Zhu Hui led the army home.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，免河南被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guichou, tax grain in disaster-stricken Henan was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Henan.

sentences.zh: 三月癸未，罷饒州督造瓷器中官。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guiwei, the eunuch supervisors of porcelain manufacture at Raozhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiwei, the court abolished Raozhou's eunuch supervisors of porcelain manufacture.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賜康海等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Kang Hai and other successful candidates of the metropolitan examination were granted jinshi ranks and appointments in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Kang Hai and other metropolitan graduates received jinshi honors and appointments according to rank.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬寅，赈京師貧民。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day renyin, relief was extended to the poor of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renyin, the court gave relief to the capital's poor.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子，免湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengzi, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengzi, autumn grain tax was remitted in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，錄劉基後裔世襲指揮使。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the day jimao, a descendant of Liu Ji was enfeoffed with hereditary rank as commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jimao, a descendant of Liu Ji was granted hereditary rank as commander.

sentences.zh: 己丑，王軾破斬米魯，貴州賊平。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Wang Shi defeated and beheaded Milu, and the rebels of Guizhou were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Shi routed and beheaded Milu, and the Guizhou rebels were pacified.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，命各邊設養濟院、漏澤園。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the throne ordered each frontier guard to establish poorhouses and public burial grounds.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court ordered every frontier guard to establish poorhouses and public burial grounds.

sentences.zh: 八月庚戌，以南京、鳳陽霪雨大風，江溢為災，遣使祭告，敕兩京臣修省。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day gengxu, because of incessant rain and great winds at Nanjing and Fengyang and flooding of the rivers, envoys were dispatched to offer prayers, and an edict ordered officials of both capitals to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengxu, after floods from heavy rain and gales at Nanjing and Fengyang, the court sent envoys to report to Heaven and ordered officials in both capitals to undertake self-examination.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the new moon day gengwu, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the new moon gengwu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 戊子，放減內府所畜鳥獸。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, birds and beasts kept in the inner palace were released and their numbers reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court released and reduced the birds and beasts kept in the inner palace.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯，罷明年上元燈火。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the day guimao, next year's Lantern Festival displays were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao, the court canceled the next year's First Full Moon lantern displays.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，瓊州黎賊作亂。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renshen, Li bandits in Qiongzhou rose in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renshen, Li rebels in Qiongzhou rose in arms.

sentences.zh: 甲午，罷廣東採珠。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, pearl diving in Guangdong was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the court ended Guangdong's pearl-diving levy.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，大明會典成。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jiyou, the Collected Statutes of the Great Ming were completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiyou, the Collected Statutes of the Great Ming were completed.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以疾不視朝。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, because of illness the emperor did not hold court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the emperor, ill, did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 是月，免南畿被災秋糧。

translations.literal: That month, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month autumn grain tax was remitted in the disaster-hit Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、安南入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Ryukyu and Annam sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ryukyu and Annam sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治十六年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year sixteen.
translations.idiomatic: The sixteenth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月癸酉，遣官代享太廟。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, first month, on the day guiyou, officials were dispatched to sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple in the emperor's stead.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, in the first month of spring, on guiyou, officials were sent to offer sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple on the emperor's behalf.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，視朝。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinchou, the emperor held court.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinchou, the emperor held court again.

sentences.zh: 戊申，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，免山西被災稅糧。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guisi, tax grain in disaster-stricken Shanxi was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥，敕宣、大嚴邊備。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the day xinhai, an edict ordered Xuanfu and Datong to tighten border defenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinhai, the throne ordered Xuanfu and Datong to tighten frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，以雲南災變敕臣修省。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wuzi, because of disasters and portents in Yunnan, an edict ordered all officials to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuzi, after disasters and portents in Yunnan, the emperor ordered his ministers to undertake court-wide self-examination.

sentences.zh: 刑部侍郎樊瑩巡視雲、貴，察官吏，問民疾苦。
