translations.literal: Vice Minister of Justice Fan Ying toured Yunnan and Guizhou, examined officials, and inquired into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: Justice Vice Minister Fan Ying toured Yunnan and Guizhou, inspected officials, and inquired into popular hardship.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，廣東官軍討黎賊，敗之。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, government troops of Guangdong campaigned against the Li rebels and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Guangdong government troops campaigned against the Li rebels and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑，赈兩畿、浙江、山東、河南、湖廣被災軍民。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day dingchou, relief was extended to soldiers and civilians in disaster-stricken districts of the Two Metropolitan Regions, Zhejiang, Shandong, Henan, and Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingchou, the court gave relief to soldiers and civilians in disaster districts of the Two Metropolitan Regions, Zhejiang, Shandong, Henan, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲戌，罷營造器物及明年上元火。

translations.literal: In winter, eleventh month, on the day jiaxu, manufacture of ritual objects and next year's Lantern Festival displays were canceled.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, on jiaxu, the court halted manufacture of ritual objects and canceled the next year's First Full Moon lantern displays.

sentences.zh: 是月，免南畿被災秋糧。

translations.literal: That month, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken districts of the Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month autumn grain tax was remitted in the disaster-hit Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，免淮、揚、浙江物料。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingwu, materials levied in Huaiyang and Zhejiang were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingwu, levies of materials in the Huai-Yang and Zhejiang sectors were remitted.

sentences.zh: 是年，安南、暹羅、哈密、土魯番、撒馬兒罕入貢。

translations.literal: That year, Annam, Siam, Hami, Turfan, and Samarkand sent tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Annam, Siam, Hami, Turfan, and Samarkand sent tribute missions.

sentences.zh: 弘治十七年

translations.literal: Hongzhi year seventeen.
translations.idiomatic: The seventeenth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 十七年春正月辛未，南京工部侍郎高銓赈應天饑。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, spring, first month, on the day xinwei, Gao Quan, Vice Minister of Works at Nanjing, gave relief to famine victims in Yingtian.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, in the first month of spring, on xinwei, Nanjing Works Vice Minister Gao Quan gave relief in the Yingtian famine.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 壬午，嚴誣告之禁。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the ban on false accusations was strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the throne strictly enforced the ban on malicious accusations.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，減供用物料。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiayin, materials for imperial use were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiayin, the court cut materials for imperial use.

sentences.zh: 己未，嚴讖緯妖書之禁。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the bans on prophecy, weft texts, and heterodox books were strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the throne strictly enforced bans on prophecy, weft texts, and heterodox books.

sentences.zh: 庚申，免浙江被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, tax grain in disaster-stricken Zhejiang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen tax grain was remitted in disaster-stricken Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，太皇太后崩。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renxu, the Grand Empress Dowager died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renxu, the Grand Empress Dowager died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，定太廟各室一帝一后之制。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the regulation was fixed that each chamber of the Grand Ancestral Temple should hold one emperor and one empress.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei the court fixed the rule that each bay of the Grand Ancestral Temple enshrines one emperor and one empress.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己酉，葬孝肅皇太后。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day jiyou, Empress Xiaosu was buried.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jiyou of the fourth month, Empress Xiaosu was interred.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛酉，闕里先師廟成，遣大學士李東陽祭告。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day xinyou, the Temple of the First Teacher at Qufu was completed; Grand Secretary Li Dongyang was dispatched to announce the completion.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinyou, the temple of the First Teacher at Qufu was finished, and Grand Secretary Li Dongyang was sent to report the event.

sentences.zh: 庚午，免山東被災稅糧。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, grain taxes in disaster-stricken Shandong were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, grain levies were forgiven in disaster-stricken Shandong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以四方災荒敕臣修省。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, in view of famine and disaster throughout the realm, an edict commanded officials to practice self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, with famine and disaster across the realm, the throne issued an edict commanding officials to examine their conduct.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，命諸司詳議害民弊政。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, all offices were ordered to deliberate in detail on harmful policies that injure the people.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen every ministry was ordered to review in detail policies that harmed the people.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，罷南京、蘇、杭織造中官。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day renchen, eunuch supervisors of weaving at Nanjing, Suzhou, and Hangzhou were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renchen, palace eunuchs overseeing the imperial looms at Nanjing, Suzhou, and Hangzhou were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，始命兩京五品以下官六年一考察。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day yihai, officials of fifth rank and below in the two capitals were for the first time subjected to performance review every six years.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai, officials of fifth rank and below in both capitals were for the first time placed on a six-year cycle of performance review.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，召劉健、李東陽於暖閣，議邊務。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Liu Jian and Li Dongyang were summoned to the Warm Pavilion to discuss frontier affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Liu Jian and Li Dongyang were called to the Warm Pavilion to deliberate on border affairs.

sentences.zh: 癸未，火篩入大同，指揮鄭瑀力戰死。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Huoshai entered Datong; Commander Zheng Yu fought fiercely and died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Huoshai entered Datong; Commander Zheng Yu fought to the end and fell.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳，工部侍郎李鐩、大理少卿吳一貫、通政司參議叢蘭分道經略邊塞。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day guisi, Vice Minister of Works Li Yong, Junior Vice President of the Court of Judicial Review Wu Yiguan, and Secretariat Participant Cong Lan were dispatched by separate routes to oversee the frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on guisi of the seventh month, Vice Minister Li Yong of Works, Junior Vice President Wu Yiguan of the Court of Judicial Review, and Secretariat Participant Cong Lan were sent by separate routes to oversee the border defenses.

sentences.zh: 甲午，左副都御史閻仲宇、通政司參議熊偉分理邊餉。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Yan Zhongyu and Secretariat Participant Xiong Wei were assigned to manage frontier supplies separately.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Left Vice Censor-in-Chief Yan Zhongyu and Secretariat Participant Xiong Wei were assigned to handle frontier provisions by separate routes.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，命天下撫、按、三司官奏軍民利病，士民建言可採者，所司以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuchen, officials of the provincial surveillance, pacification, and trinity commissions throughout the realm were ordered to memorialize benefits and harms to troops and civilians; worthy proposals from scholars and commoners were to be reported by the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuchen, provincial surveillance, pacification, and trinity commissioners were ordered to report what helped or harmed soldiers and civilians; worthy proposals from scholars and commoners were to be forwarded by the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免南畿被災夏稅。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, summer tax in the disaster-stricken Southern Metropolitan Region was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen summer grain tax was remitted in the disaster-stricken Southern Metropolitan Region.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，召馬文升、戴珊於暖閣，諭以明年考察，務訪實蹟，以求至當。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Ma Wensheng and Dai Shan were summoned to the Warm Pavilion and instructed that next year's performance reviews must seek verified facts to achieve the most fitting judgments.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Ma Wensheng and Dai Shan were summoned to the Warm Pavilion and told that next year's reviews must rest on verified facts so that judgments would be as fair as possible.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，諭法司不得任情偏執，致淹獄囚。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day gengyin, the judicial offices were admonished not to indulge partisan bias and thereby prolong the detention of prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengyin, the judicial offices were warned not to indulge bias and thereby keep prisoners languishing in custody.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太常少卿孫交經略宣、大邊務。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Vice Minister of Court Ceremonies Sun Jiao was sent to oversee affairs on the Xuan and Datong frontiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Vice Minister Sun Jiao of Court Ceremonies was sent to take charge of affairs on the Xuanfu and Datong frontiers.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，御暖閣，諭劉健、李東陽、謝遷：「諸邊首功，巡按御史察勘，動淹歲年，非所以示勸。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, at the Warm Pavilion, he instructed Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian: "As to frontier merit awards, touring censor investigations drag on for years—this is no way to encourage merit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, at the Warm Pavilion, he told Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian: "When frontier merit is reported, touring censors take years to verify it—hardly a way to encourage valor.

sentences.zh: 自今奏報，以遠近立限。

translations.literal: From now on, memorials reporting such deeds shall set deadlines according to distance.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, reports of such deeds shall fix deadlines according to distance.

sentences.zh: 違者詰治。

translations.literal: Those who violate this shall be called to account."
translations.idiomatic: Whoever violates this shall be called to account."

sentences.zh: 」諭講官進講直言毋諱。

translations.literal: He also instructed the lecture officials to advance in their lectures and speak bluntly without reserve.
translations.idiomatic: He also instructed the lecture officials to press forward in their lectures and speak frankly without holding back.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊子，罷雲南銀場。

translations.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day wuzi, Yunnan silver mines were closed.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on wuzi of the eleventh month, Yunnan's silver mines were shut down.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，申閉糴之禁。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day gengwu, the prohibition against neighbors' hoarding grain was reaffirmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengwu, the ban on neighboring districts' hoarding grain was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 甲申，免湖廣被災秋糧。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, autumn grain tax in disaster-stricken Huguang was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen autumn grain tax was forgiven in disaster-stricken Huguang.

sentences.zh: 是年，琉球、撒馬兒罕、哈密、烏斯藏入貢。

translations.literal: That year envoys came with tribute from Ryukyu, Samarkand, Hami, and U-Tsang.
translations.idiomatic: During the year, envoys arrived with tribute from Ryukyu, Samarkand, Hami, and U-Tsang.

sentences.zh: 弘治十八年

translations.literal: The eighteenth year of the Hongzhi reign.
translations.idiomatic: The eighteenth year of the Hongzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 十八年春正月己丑，小王子諸部圍靈州，入花馬池，遂掠韋州、環縣。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on the day jichou, the Little Prince's tribes invested Lingzhou, entered Huamachi, then plundered Weizhou and Huan County.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, on jichou of the first month, the Little Prince's tribes besieged Lingzhou, entered Huamachi, and then raided Weizhou and Huan County.

sentences.zh: 戶部侍郎顧佐理陝西軍餉。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Revenue Gu Zu took charge of military supplies in Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister Gu Zu of Revenue was sent to manage military provisions in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大祀天地於南郊。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth was performed at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the emperor offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，小王子陷寧夏清水營。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Little Prince took Qing Shui Camp in Ningxia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Little Prince seized Qing Shui Camp in Ningxia.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，御奉天門，諭戶、兵、工三部曰：「方今生齒漸繁，而戶口、軍伍日就耗損，此皆官司撫卹無方，因仍苟且所致。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day wuchen, at Fengtian Gate he addressed the Ministries of Revenue, War, and Works: "Population is growing ever denser, yet household registers and military rolls dwindle daily—all because officials nurse the people carelessly and cling to old abuses.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen, at Fengtian Gate he addressed the Ministries of Revenue, War, and Works: "The population grows ever denser, yet household registers and military rolls shrink day by day—all because officials have failed to nurture the people and cling to old abuses.

sentences.zh: 其悉議弊政以聞。

translations.literal: You are all to deliberate on harmful policies and report."
translations.idiomatic: Deliberate on harmful policies in full and report."

sentences.zh: 」三月癸卯，賜顧鼎臣等進士及第、出身有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day guimao, Gu Dingchen and other advanced-degree graduates received jinshi honors and ranked chushen with distinctions by standing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guimao, Gu Dingchen and the other graduates received advanced and initial degrees, with ranks apportioned by standing.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅，刑部侍郎何鑑撫輯荊、襄流民。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day wuyin, Vice Minister of Justice He Jian was sent to settle and pacify displaced people in Jing and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on wuyin of the fourth month, Vice Minister He Jian of Justice was sent to settle displaced people in Jing and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 甲申，帝不豫。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the Emperor fell gravely ill.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Emperor fell gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，大漸，召大學士劉健、李東陽、謝遷受顧命。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day gengyin, his condition became critical; Grand Secretaries Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian were summoned to receive his deathbed testament.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengyin, his illness turned critical; Grand Secretaries Liu Jian, Li Dongyang, and Xie Qian were summoned to receive his deathbed charge.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，崩於乾清宮，年三十有六。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao he died in the Hall of Imperial Peace, aged thirty-six.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he died in the Hall of Imperial Peace, aged thirty-six.

sentences.zh: 六月庚申，上尊謚，廟號孝宗，葬泰陵。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengshen, posthumous titles were granted, the temple name Xiaozong was bestowed, and he was buried at Tailing.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengshen, posthumous honors were granted, the temple name Xiaozong was bestowed, and he was buried at Tailing.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：明有天下，傳世十六，太祖、成祖而外，可稱者仁宗、宣宗、孝宗而已。

translations.literal: The appraisal says: Of those who held the Ming realm across sixteen reigns, besides the founding Taizu and Chengzu, only Renzong, Xuanzong, and Xiaozong may truly be named.
translations.idiomatic: The appraisal says: Among the sixteen who have held the Ming realm, apart from the founding Taizu and Chengzu, only Renzong, Xuanzong, and Xiaozong truly deserve the name.

sentences.zh: 仁、宣之際，國勢初張，綱紀修立，淳樸未漓。

translations.literal: In the age of Ren and Xuan the state was just expanding, institutions were being set in order, and simplicity had not yet been diluted.
translations.idiomatic: In the age of Renzong and Xuanzong the state was still gathering strength, institutions were being set in order, and plain custom had not yet been worn thin.

sentences.zh: 至成化以來，號為太平無事，而晏安則易耽怠玩，富盛則漸啟驕奢。

translations.literal: From Chenghua onward the age was called one of peace without disturbance, yet ease bred slackness and excess, and prosperity gradually opened the way to pride and luxury.
translations.idiomatic: From Chenghua onward the age was called peaceful and untroubled, yet ease bred slackness and indulgence, and growing wealth gradually opened the way to pride and luxury.

sentences.zh: 孝宗獨能恭儉有制，勤政愛民，兢兢於保泰持盈之道，用使朝序清寧，民物康阜。

translations.literal: Xiaozong alone maintained disciplined frugality, diligent government, and care for the people, ever watchful in holding fast to the way of preserving prosperity without spillover—so that court order stayed clear and the people's lot grew secure and abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong alone held to disciplined frugality, diligent government, and care for the people, ever watchful in the way of preserving prosperity without overreach—so that court order stayed clear and the people's lot grew secure and abundant.

sentences.zh: 易曰：「平不陂，往不復，艱貞咎。

translations.literal: The Book of Changes says: "Without level ground there is no slope; without going forth there is no return; steadfastness in hardship brings no blame."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Changes says: "Without level ground there is no slope; without going forth there is no return; steadfastness in hardship brings no blame."

sentences.zh: 」知此道者，其惟孝宗乎。

translations.literal: Of those who understand this principle, was it not Xiaozong?
translations.idiomatic: Of those who grasp this principle, was it not Xiaozong?

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation notes
translations.idiomatic: Collation notes

sentences.zh: [一] 孝宗建天明道誠純中正聖文神武至仁大德敬皇帝 建天，原作「達天」，誠純，原作「純誠」，據孝宗實錄改。

translations.literal: [1] Xiaozong Jiantian Mingdao Chengcun Zhongzheng Shengwen Shenwu Zhiren Dade Jing Emperor — jian tian: the original read "da tian"; chengcun: the original read "chuncheng"; emended per the Xiaozong Veritable Records.
translations.idiomatic: [1] "Xiaozong Jiantian Mingdao Chengcun Zhongzheng Shengwen Shenwu Zhiren Dade Jing Emperor": jian tian originally read da tian; chengcun originally read chuncheng; both emended on the authority of the Xiaozong Shilu.

sentences.zh: [二] 九月己酉禁勢家侵奪民利 原脫「九月」。

translations.literal: [2] Ninth month, jiyou, prohibition on powerful families' seizure of popular profit — the original omitted "ninth month."
translations.idiomatic: [2] "Ninth month, jiyou, prohibition on powerful families' seizure of popular profit": the original omitted "ninth month."

sentences.zh: 「己酉」承上文「八月」，即成為八月己酉。

translations.literal: "Jiyou" followed the preceding "eighth month" and would thus become eighth-month jiyou.
translations.idiomatic: "Jiyou" followed the preceding "eighth month" and would thus be read as jiyou of the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 按是年八月乙亥朔，不得有己酉日。

translations.literal: That year the first day of the eighth month was yihai; there could be no jiyou day.
translations.idiomatic: That year the first day of the eighth month was yihai; there could be no jiyou day in that month.

sentences.zh: 孝宗實錄卷一一七繫「己酉」於九月，據補。

translations.literal: The Xiaozong Veritable Records, juan 117, place "jiyou" in the ninth month; supplied here on that authority.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiaozong Shilu, juan 117, places "jiyou" in the ninth month; supplied here on that authority.

sentences.zh: [三] 九月壬午普安賊婦米魯作亂 孝宗實錄卷一五一、國榷卷四四頁二七三七均繫於六月癸卯。

translations.literal: [3] Ninth month, renwu, the Pu'an bandit woman Milu rebelled — the Xiaozong Veritable Records, juan 151, and the Guoque, juan 44, p. 2737, both date it to the sixth month on guimao.
translations.idiomatic: [3] "Ninth month, renwu, the Pu'an bandit woman Milu rebelled": the Xiaozong Shilu, juan 151, and the Guoque, juan 44, p. 2737, both date the outbreak to the sixth month on guimao.

sentences.zh: 此「九月壬午」係兵部議奏征討之日，非始事之日，參見孝宗實錄卷一五四。

translations.literal: This "ninth month, renwu" is the day the Ministry of War deliberated and memorialized on the campaign, not the day the rebellion began; see the Xiaozong Veritable Records, juan 154.
translations.idiomatic: This "ninth month, renwu" is the day the Ministry of War deliberated and memorialized on the punitive campaign, not the day the rebellion began; see the Xiaozong Shilu, juan 154.

sentences.zh: [四] 遊擊將軍張俊禦之 張俊，原作「張浚」，據本書卷一七五張俊傳、孝宗實錄卷一六二改。

translations.literal: [4] Guerrilla General Zhang Jun to repel the bandits — Zhang Jun: the original read "Zhang Jun (浚)"; emended per this book, juan 175, Biography of Zhang Jun, and the Xiaozong Veritable Records, juan 162.
translations.idiomatic: [4] "Guerrilla General Zhang Jun to repel the bandits": Zhang Jun—the original read Zhang Jun (浚); emended per this book, juan 175, Biography of Zhang Jun, and the Xiaozong Shilu, juan 162.

sentences.zh: [五] 起秦紘為戶部尚書兼副都御史 秦紘，原作「秦」。

translations.literal: [5] Qin Hong recalled as Minister of Revenue and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief — Qin Hong: the original read a corrupted form.
translations.idiomatic: [5] "Qin Hong recalled as Minister of Revenue and concurrent Vice Censor-in-Chief": Qin Hong—the original bore a corrupted graph.

sentences.zh: 本書卷一六武宗紀、孝宗實錄卷一七九都作「秦紘」。

translations.literal: This book, juan 16, Wuzong Annals, and the Xiaozong Veritable Records, juan 179, all read Qin Hong.
translations.idiomatic: This book, juan 16, Wuzong Annals, and the Xiaozong Shilu, juan 179, all read Qin Hong.

sentences.zh: 按本書卷一七八有秦紘傳，事跡與紀合，據改。

translations.literal: According to this book, juan 178, there is a biography of Qin Hong; the facts accord with the annals; emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Collation: a biography of Qin Hong appears in this book, juan 178, and the account matches the annals entry; the text is corrected on that authority.
